findings: String keys with a given prefix form one contiguous lexical interval. Included(prefix) followed by take_while(starts_with(prefix)) returns the same key/value order as the former whole-map filter, including empty, absent, nested and maximum-Unicode prefixes; it needs no computed overflowing upper bound.

View::scan still saves the complete matching immutable base snapshot and overlays current writes. Patch::current still compares the complete current prefix key/value iterator with the saved snapshot and preserves all point-read checks, so prefix insertions, removals and value changes remain conflicts.

PacketCodecContext clones the same Config that Settings::clone previously cloned, and no validation result is cached. The removed genesis/initial/operator material was not consumed by these codec operations.

Both Settings and the new context return the same app.network/app.parameters fields. Each encode/decode still calls the unchanged profile selection and bounded packet grammar; malformed-hex checks remain before decoding.

History constructs the context inside the same owner access. Its control/checkpoint calls, work verification, completion network/parameter checks, canonical encoded identity and live identity promotion remain at the reviewed call sites.
conclusion: No new blocking source defect was found in these reviewed deltas.
